app.description: An AI study companion for children

onboarding.title: Choose your language to start
onboarding.description: We will add a starter worksheet in your chosen language to your library.
onboarding.note: You can change the app language later. Your worksheet will keep its original language.

starterMaterial.title: Getting started with TutoTuto
starterMaterial.subtitle: Try selecting a problem, writing an answer and getting AI feedback.

steps.title: Open the material
steps.body: Choose this material from your library.

steps.title: Turn the page
steps.body: Use the down arrow on the right to open page 2. The up arrow takes you back.

steps.title: Select a problem
steps.body: Use the selection button to enclose the problem and its answer space.

steps.title: Write your answer
steps.body: Use handwriting or text in the answer panel.

steps.title: Get AI feedback
steps.body: Press Grade, then read the result and explanation.

steps.title: Open social media
steps.body: Press View Social Media and choose a configured link.

steps.title: Return to studying
steps.body: Check the timer. When time is up, close the social media tab and return.

sections.title: Write in English.
items: ① 私はリンゴが好きです。
② 彼は背が高いです。

starterMaterial.tryOne: Try one problem. Select both the question and its answer space.
starterMaterial.network: AI grading requires an internet connection.

practice.title: A little more practice
practice.subtitle: You turned the page. Try some new problems next.

steps.title: Go back and return
steps.body: Use the up arrow on the right to go to page 1, then the down arrow to return here.

steps.title: Choose one problem
steps.body: Pick a calculation or a translation problem to try.

steps.title: Try AI grading
steps.body: Select the question and answer space, write your answer, then press Grade.

sections.title: Write in English.
items: ① 私は犬が好きです。
② これは私の本です。
